groups.home.title: Group home
groups.home.intro: Your group's gift draw happens here. Sign in with your personal link or your code, find out who you are buying a gift for and write your letter.
groups.home.privacy: This page shows nobody. Only your personal link opens your draw.
groups.error.title: Page not found
groups.create.title: New Secret Santa
groups.create.password_hint: Set when the server was deployed. It is only used to create groups.
groups.create.name: Group name
groups.create.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (3 to 40 characters). Example: family-2026. Some words are reserved: admin, api, assets, health...
groups.create.budget_hint: You can set it later. Without a budget, the Budget line does not appear for participants.
groups.create.reveal_hint: Without a date, each participant finds out their target as soon as the draw is made.
groups.create.admin_view: The organizer can look up a pair
groups.create.admin_view_hint: Off by default. If you turn it on, every lookup is recorded in the log visible to all participants.
groups.create.error.limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
groups.create.error.validation: Check the fields: a name, an address (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens), a budget in euros or empty, and valid dates.
groups.create.error.conflict: This address is already taken. Pick another one.
groups.create.error.reveal: The reveal date is not valid.
groups.create.error.slug_reserved: “{slug}” is reserved by the app. Try family-2026.
groups.create.error.slug_syntax: “{slug}” is not a valid address: lowercase letters without accents, digits and hyphens (3 to 40 characters). Try family-2026.
groups.create.error.slug_taken: “{slug}” is already taken. Pick another one.
groups.created.title: Group created
groups.created.heading: Group created: access generated
groups.created.intro: Here is your organizer secret for {name}, shown only once. Copy it now.
groups.created.copy_failed: Copy failed: select the secret and copy it by hand.
groups.created.lost: Lost it? A new secret can be generated from the admin area, or with the server command.
